requirement: Generate property-test data for a booking system with a Hypothesis composite strategy that only produces valid stays and honours its own length parameter.
skeleton: A frozen Booking dataclass with nights and half-open overlaps, a validating make_booking, and an st.composite bookings strategy bounded in dates and length.
caption: A hotel booking model with a Hypothesis composite strategy, using hypothesis strategies, datetime and dataclasses. Booking is a frozen dataclass with nights and overlaps, where back-to-back stays sharing a check-out and check-in day do not overlap. make_booking raises ValueError unless the stay lasts 1 to MAX_NIGHTS nights inclusive. bookings is an st.composite strategy that draws a check-in date within a year of EPOCH and a stay length bounded by its max_nights argument, then builds the booking through make_booking so every example is valid. The fixture asserts, with derandomized settings, valid stays near EPOCH, the max_nights narrowing, non-overlapping back-to-back stays, that find reaches 1 and 30 nights, and the ValueError cases.

constraints: make_booking raises ValueError unless nights is within 1..MAX_NIGHTS inclusive
Stays are half-open, so back-to-back stays do not overlap
bookings draws check-in dates within a year of EPOCH

rationale.teaches: Build composite strategies from bounded primitives and route them through the domain constructor so generated data is always valid.
rationale.why: Unbounded or ignored strategy parameters generate data outside the domain, and closed intervals make adjacent bookings collide.

ops.docstring: Hypothesis composite strategies that only build valid hotel bookings.

ops.stmt: from hypothesis import strategies as st

candidates.why_wrong: Back-to-back bookings sharing a changeover day are reported as overlapping.
A zero-night stay is accepted as a valid booking.
The max_nights argument is ignored and long stays are still generated.
Check-in dates are drawn from all of history, far outside the booking window.
The maximum thirty-night stay is rejected by make_booking.
